title: Car Thief Tries To Run From Police, Gets His Face Busted
description:
On April 16th, 2023, officers were dispatched in response to a vehicle prowl in progress. CCTV camera footage showed a man forcefully entering a silver KIA and opening its bonnet with criminal intent, completely unaware of the approaching police officers. At this point, the man knew he was in serious trouble and was ready to make a run to evade the police. After getting arrested, people often become argumentative and talk back. The man made the the same mistake. Luckily, there was a witness at the scene when the incident occurred. Another officer inspected the car the suspect was prowling around. It appeared as though he was searching for something. The male was charged with vehicle prowl and resisting arrest.
